_comment: Graded queries for MRR@k. 'expected_chunk_ids' are the chunks that genuinely answer the question; MRR credits only the first one retrieved. Chunk IDs follow the '<source_filename>__chunk_<index>' scheme written by vector_store.add_chunks(). Splits are stratified so 'dev' and 'test' each span the source documents: tune on dev, keep test held out.
